team.name: Elad Maor Hefets
team.bio: The heart behind it all. Elad is the one who saw the possibility before anyone else did—and then made it happen. A family-first kind of guy with a mind full of ideas and a whiteboard always nearby. He's the glue, the dreamer, and the reason we're all here.

team.name: Alex Shraibman
team.bio: The technical mastermind behind The HBM. Alex transforms complex visions into seamless, scalable reality. With a razor-sharp focus on architecture and user experience, he's the one making sure the magic happens reliably and beautifully.

team.name: Tal Zohar
team.bio: Tal's the force that keeps everything grounded, on track, and somehow still smiling. While we joke that she's the CEO in practice, no one's arguing. With a calm presence and sharp instincts, she quietly (but powerfully) makes sure things actually get done.

team.name: Michal Merjan
team.bio: More than just our office manager—Michal is the pulse, the hug, the one who remembers your birthday and your caffeine preference. Her love for cats is legendary, and honestly, we suspect they help her run the place behind the scenes.

team.name: Yuval Hefets
team.bio: The older twin (by technicality, not by maturity), Yuval brings sharp focus and fresh curiosity into everything he does. Recently diving into data analysis, he's all about finding the hidden patterns behind how people connect. Equal parts thoughtful and turbocharged, he's proof that energy and insight make a powerful combo.

team.name: Liad Hefets
team.bio: If marketing had a hype squad, Liad would lead it. Bold, warm, and always two steps ahead, he's got a gift for opening doors—and conversations. While Yuval dives into data, Liad dives into people. Together, they're a force. Separately? Still unstoppable.

team.name: Shon Hazan
team.bio: Shon came to us from Canada with a smile that feels like a warm welcome and a network that seems to span half the planet. After years in clean energy and international business, he randomly showed up at one of our Friday events and walked out with a job offer from Elad. Since then, he has been our door opener, deal starter, and the person who can turn any conversation into an opportunity.

testimonials.quote: The Meeter event in the hotel lobby was simply incredible! As a hotel, we're always looking for ways to create a unique experience and added value for our guests, and that's exactly what happened. Within minutes the atmosphere in the lobby changed - guests stopped looking at their phones and started talking, laughing, and getting to know each other. Beyond the amazing social experience, it was also felt directly on the bottom line: people stayed in the lobby, the energy was high, and bar sales jumped significantly. It turned the evening from just a hotel stay into an unforgettable community experience.
testimonials.author: Eden Alfasi

testimonials.quote: At Dale Carnegie we teach people how to build connections, and HBM gives the perfect platform to put that into practice. Our collaboration, both at our alumni events and at the High-Tech Park in Tel Aviv, proved that when you combine quality content with smart technology, the magic happens. Participants didn't just 'learn' about networking - they experienced it in real time in the most effective way possible.
testimonials.author: Gilad Newman

testimonials.quote: As someone responsible for alumni events of the various schools at Reichman University, my challenge is to ensure that meaningful connections are created at events - the kind that lead to new and exciting opportunities. Meeter allowed us to connect alumni in a new way. Instead of alumni looking for familiar faces and connecting only with people they knew before, they went straight into 8-minute deep conversations with people they hadn't met before, from different years or diverse study tracks. It's a refreshing tool for anyone who wants to create light, door-opening networking at their event.
testimonials.author: Hila
testimonials.role: Alumni Events and Community Manager, Reichman University
